scenarios.name: Baseline
scenarios.assumptions: The selected model's own dynamics; no shift.

scenarios.name: Accelerated China pull
scenarios.assumptions: Chinese demand and finance keep growing: the yearly change in the export share to China is 2 points above the model's, the share to the United States 1 point below; the index moves 2 points a year toward China and 1 away from the United States.

scenarios.name: US sourcing rules bite
scenarios.assumptions: IRA-style sourcing rules, the Minerals Security Partnership and tariffs divert flows: the yearly change in the export share to the United States is 2 points above the model's, the share to China 2 points below; the index moves 2 points a year each way.

BOL.parliament_note: The Asamblea Legislativa Plurinacional publishes no API, no roll-call data and no transcripts; the Gaceta's full text is paywalled.

ECU.parliament_note: The Asamblea adapter ran and returned no records: the bills database is HTML only and the plenary-votes page is a script-rendered application whose data service is not exposed.

GUY.parliament_note: The Parliament of Guyana publishes Hansard as PDF only, with no structured bill or vote records.

SUR.parliament_note: De Nationale Assemblée publishes bills as Dutch PDFs; debates and roll-calls are not online.

VEN.parliament_note: Two assemblies claim legitimacy; neither publishes structured bill or vote records.
